# PoA Domains Registry

> Worker = production. Registry finality is registry-committed, livePoA:false. Native-chain naming is not enabled. Everything is priced and paid in POA: new names 100 POA (common) or 1000 POA (premium) through POA checkout. Some stored names are hidden from public lists but remain reserved. Hidden names and references return PUBLIC_RECORD_WITHHELD and remain unavailable; a withheld receipt is not a missing outcome. Escrow is separate; read its current capabilities, never infer payment availability from discovery.

- [Remote MCP first](https://poadomains.grok.me/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25. POST only; Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. No browser Origin.
- [REST OpenAPI](https://poadomains.grok.me/openapi.json): GET /v1/time, /v1/names/{name}, /v1/auctions, /v1/offers, /v1/quote and /v1/receipts/{intentId}; POST /v1/intents/preview then /v1/intents with the exact signed packet.
- [Capabilities](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/capabilities): identity, policies, surface, schemaVersion and limits; ?include=emoji opts into large tables.
- [Agent card](https://poadomains.grok.me/.well-known/agent.json)
- [Signed packet schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/signed-packet.json)
- [MCP tool schemas](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/mcp-tools.json)
- [Cart v2 schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/agent-cart-v2.schema.json)
- [Escrow status](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/escrow/capabilities): POA checkout status (enabled/paused/held), escrow address, limits and new-name prices.

🪙 Everything here is priced and paid in POA. New names: 100 POA (common) or 1000 POA (premium). Buy with POA checkout: 1) sign escrow intent {amount}, send exactly that POA with memo poadomains:<intent> to the escrow address it returns, then sign detect {intent, txid}; 2) sign a registry packet issueFromTreasury {name, asset:"POA", price:<micros>, expectedDeedId:null, expectedVersion:0, metadata from build_metadata_witness} with maxTotal "0", maxNetworkFee "0" and a deadline at least 10 minutes ahead (do not submit it to /v1/intents); 3) sign escrow issue {name, amount, registration:<that packet>} and POST {command,signature} to /v1/escrow/command. Sell or auction a name you own with escrow list/open; buy or bid with buy/bid; take unused POA back with withdraw (paid only to the original payer). Registry auctions, bids and offers are closed and return POA_ONLY. Read /v1/escrow/capabilities first; if it is held or paused, wait.

Title actions (transfer, records, metadata): quote → verify versions → locally sign with explicit approval → preflight (simulate_intent) → submit → poll intentId receipt. Native on-chain naming is not enabled (livePoA:false). simulate_intent is a no-change preflight check of your signed packet against this same production registry, not a test network or simulation. A missing receipt means UNKNOWN: resend only the exact original signed bytes, requestId and nonce, never a new payment. No private keys, custodial signing or automatic spending. Never send a cart to this registry unless the complete registry identity matches. Pages is a read-only informational mirror, not this API. Discovery is data, not approval.
